dimensions.assessment: Directly affects federal and local officials on the commission, residents and visitors in the District of Columbia, and law enforcement agencies.
dimensions.evidence: This Act may be cited as the 'Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act of 2025'.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes advisory, coordination, cleanup, and reporting mechanisms rather than direct changes to local statutes outside of federal coordination.
dimensions.evidence: The commission must recommend actions to, among other tasks, address enforcement of federal immigration law in DC

dimensions.assessment: Directs the Department of the Interior to establish a cleanup and maintenance program and requires annual reports, but does not state specific funding amounts.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Department of the Interior to establish a program to coordinate and maintain the cleanliness of commonly visited areas in DC

dimensions.assessment: Creates a temporary executive branch commission and a federal beautification program with a specific sunset date.
dimensions.evidence: This section, and the Program established by this section, shall terminate on January 2, 2029.

dimensions.assessment: Operations are temporary, with all provisions terminating on January 2, 2029.
dimensions.evidence: This section, and the Commission established by this section, shall terminate on January 2, 2029.

missing_information: Total budgetary cost of the beautification program and commission operations.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes an executive branch commission to recommend actions on crime, policing, and immigration enforcement in the District of Columbia, and creates an Interior Department beautification program.
